visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a white short-sleeved athletic top and blue shorts, performs a full split on a light-colored indoor floor. A young man wearing a black shirt, a black cap, and glasses stands behind her, placing his hands on her back to guide her posture. The room is modern with a glass display cabinet filled with various figurines and collectibles in the background. A smartphone held by an unseen person is visible in the foreground, recording the scene. (2) The scene cuts to a different woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark green t-shirt and black trousers, sitting at a marble-topped table while looking down at her phone with a hunched back. The same man in black stands beside her and taps her shoulder. She immediately straightens her back and smiles toward the camera. The background shows a modern hallway with soft lighting. (3) The video cuts back to the first woman in the white top. She is now standing and holding one leg vertically against a cabinet, showing extreme flexibility. The man stands next to her, assisting her balance and ensuring her back is straight. The setting is the same figurine-filled room. (4) The final scene shows the second woman in the green top leaning over to look at a shelf filled with high-end sneakers. The man stands behind her and gestures for her to stand up straight. She complies, straightening her posture and looking ahead while he stands beside her.
